jobs.objective: Implement RFC 0170 P0 in Go, contract-first, per the falsification-cleared SPEC — the REQUIRED context doc docs/operator/artifacts/rfc-0170-p0-design-v5/commit/proposal/PROPOSAL.md. READ IT IN FULL (it is the authority; do not re-derive it) — especially §0 the observe-only boundary, §2 the migration substrate (G3/C1-C3), §3 the Tier-1 predicate clauses 1-5 (G1/A1-A8), §4 DecayTickSweep (G2/B1-B5, the off-the-wait-path fold + latency machinery), §5 forward-compat (G4/D1), §6 the P0/P1+ boundary, §7 the assertion ledger, and §F the two non-blocking build-carries BC-618 / BC-619. The cleared adjudicator ledger (COLLABORATION_LEDGER_cycle_1.md) records the four gate dispositions and the build-carry verification gates — honor them. P0 is OBSERVE-ONLY: it writes a candidacy ledger nothing acts on — NO deletion, NO tombstone, NO page, NO doctor RED/amber, NO run-admission effect. Implement ALL of the following in your per-job worktree under go/. (1) SUBSTRATE — the runtime migration go/pkg/db/sql/0045_cullable_entity.sql (VERIFY 0045 is still the free slot: `ls go/pkg/db/sql/0045*` must be empty; the highest is 0044_deploy_cursor.sql): CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS striatumd.cullable_entity (kind text, ref text, last_reinforced_at timestamptz, decay_score double precision, reachable_from_root boolean, candidacy_state text) with PRIMARY KEY (kind, ref), CHECK (kind IN ('code_symbol','file','package','branch','rfc','decision','doc','table')), CHECK (candidacy_state IN ('nominated','withdrawn')); modeled byte-for-byte on 0042_verifier_attestations.sql / 0043_schema_state.sql / 0044_deploy_cursor.sql with NO foreign keys and NO owner-held-table DDL (the >=27 guards TestFutureRuntimeMigrationsDoNotCarryOwnerDDL / TestFutureRuntimeMigrationsDoNotFKOwnerHeldTables forbid ALTER/DROP of striatumd.* and FKs to owner tables); followed by the DO $$ guarded GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE ON striatumd.cullable_entity TO striatumd_rw (NO DELETE grant — withdrawal is an UPDATE). (2) RESERVATIONS — add the row ordinal=45, file="0045_cullable_entity.sql" to go/pkg/db/sql/RESERVATIONS.toml in the SAME change (TestReservationLedgerMatchesOnDisk reds on a missing/duplicate/gap row). (3) AUTHORITY INVENTORY (C1) — add BOTH rows: readAuthorityInventory["cullable_entity"] = ReadClassRuntimeOperational in go/pkg/db/read_authority_inventory.go AND writeAuthorityInventory["cullable_entity"] = ClassRuntimeDML in go/pkg/db/write_authority_inventory.go (omitting either red-mains TestRead/WriteAuthorityInventoryCoversEmbeddedTablesWithoutPostgres + authority_inventory_static_test.go, no Postgres needed). (4) NO SELECT * (C3) — every read of cullable_entity projects an explicit column list (the sweep's existing-state read selects exactly `kind, ref, candidacy_state`); the #614/bundle-0022 SEV-1 lesson. (5) TIER-1 PREDICATE (§3, G1) — the mechanical pure-grep predicate (no LLM, no external/network/open-issue/mutable-outside-tree state) over kind in {rfc, decision, doc}; an entity is `nominated` iff ALL five clauses hold: clause 1 structural status field begins (case-insensitive) `superseded`/`tombstoned` ONLY (read per kind: rfc title-block `Status:` AND `**Status:**` both spellings in first ~8 lines; decision = cell 2 (2nd pipe cell) of docs/decisions/decision-log.md; doc front-matter `Status:`) — body prose ignored; clause 2 a parseable LIVE successor with the kind=decision extraction rule (own-row cell 3 then cell 5 by precedence, regex \bsupersed(?:ed|es) by\s+<reflist>, reflist = D0*N|RFC[ -]0*N split on /,`,`, ` and `, terminating at the sentence/clause boundary; rfc/doc parse refs after `by` in the Status line) and liveness resolution (D267->{D270} live; D081->{D087,D094,D104} live; bare-state-only superseded e.g. D084 WITHHELD); clause 3 the FULLY-STATIC tree-local protected pathspec (checked-in constant manifest, NO external-state term — it is `.check-docs-ignore` minus docs/rfcs/ plus the never-cullable root files: docs/records/_frozen/**, docs/research/**, docs/dogfood/**, docs/handoffs/**, docs/operator/plans/**, docs/operator/workflows/**, examples/**, prompts/**, and root files docs/reference/spec.md, docs/reference/prd.md, README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/index.md, docs/operator/rfc-roadmap.md; docs/rfcs/ and docs/decisions/ stay ELIGIBLE); clause 4 no live ACTIVE-BASELINE inbound citation (4a canonical ref forms word-bounded; 4b fixed inbound-scan set; 4c live source not under a protected/frozen root — NOTE the static manifest covers _frozen/** but NOT status:frozen records under docs/records/audits/, which stay live in P0 = the documented #618 false negative; 4d not self; 4e not a named-successor backref; 4f not a disposable line by fixed regex (reference-link def | README index row | a FIXED closure lexicon {superseded, supersede, deprecat, obsolete, retired, tombston, graveyard, historical, formerly, "closed-out", "closed out", "do not pick up", "see also", "no longer"} on the matched physical line)); clause 5 kind=branch EXCLUDED (namespace allowlist; backup/*, tags/graveyard/* protected). reachable_from_root = OR of clauses 3 and 4. decay_score is the constant sentinel 0.0 (P0 runs no decay clock). candidacy_state machine: predicate true -> nominated + last_reinforced_at=now(); previously-nominated now-false -> withdrawn; a candidacy row is NEVER deleted (idempotent UPSERT on (kind, ref)). (6) DECAYTICKSWEEP (§4, G2) — DecayTickSweep.SweepOnce in go/pkg/recovery riding the existing recovery tick at the RFC-0137 metrics-fold position (after innerSweep, the main.go fold around the ActiveRunSweep wrap) but OFF the wait-gating path: the fold position does ONLY O(1) work (single-in-flight slot check; if free, launch a DETACHED scan goroutine and RETURN IMMEDIATELY; if a prior scan is still in flight, SKIP-on-overrun, logged) and NEVER joins/waits on the scan; the recovery sweep's own (result, sweepErr) is returned unchanged. New constant DefaultCullFoldTimeout = 10 * time.Second in go/pkg/recovery (a static test asserts DefaultCullFoldTimeout < DefaultSweepInterval). Inside the detached goroutine: cullCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(sweepCtx, DefaultCullFoldTimeout) with defer cancel() OWNED IN THE GOROUTINE (the fold position must NOT hold the cancel); L2 the DB read runs under cullCtx AND issues SET LOCAL statement_timeout='10000' at the head of its read txn; L3 the filesystem scan is COOPERATIVE (fs.WalkDir callback returns cullCtx.Err() once the deadline passes; each file read through a bounded reader over only the front-matter head ~8 lines); L4 compute-then-commit — compute the FULL candidacy delta in memory (reads only), then perform the cullable_entity UPSERTs as ONE all-or-nothing transaction on its OWN short-lived pooled connection ONLY when the scan completed before cullCtx fired (zero writes on timeout/non-return); the panic/error recover seam lives at the TOP FRAME of the detached goroutine (runDecayTickSweep: recover() -> log.Printf loud + debug.Stack() -> goroutine exits cleanly, writing nothing), mirroring runPerRunSweep. Wire the fold into cmd/striatumd/main.go at the metrics-fold position. BC-619: keep the fold detached and O(1) with NO select-on-scan-done join back into the recovery goroutine. (7) TESTS — (G1) the KNOWN-SET table-driven corpus test (BC-618) over the live tree asserting ZERO false POSITIVES on the known preserved set (rfc:0097/0027/0039/0041 withheld by clause 4, rfc:0028 by clause 2, the still-cited superseded decisions incl. D174, the six backup/rfc-* branches, docs/records/_frozen/**, and the RFC-0170 body/SEED/workflow.json/decision-log prose), the known-dead decision:D267 NOMINATED end-to-end, and decision:D081 recorded as the DOCUMENTED #618 WITHHELD member (cause: the status:frozen audit docs/records/audits/STRIATUM_DECISION_RECORD_AUDIT_OPUS_4_8_2026-06-16.md citation at :323/:367-370) — plus a constructed bare-superseded negative-control fixture row (state cell superseded, cells 3/5 no `superseded by`) that withholds independently of tree drift, and a protected-pathspec fixture proving clause 3 is tree-local and passes with NO network/GitHub access; (G2) the B2 panic-isolation regression test (mirror TestActiveRunSweepPanicDegradesRunAndContinues in go/pkg/recovery/sweep_panic_test.go — inject a panicking scan; assert the detached goroutine recovers+logs+exits without writing, the recovery tick returns its own result unchanged, the daemon is not canceled); the B5 HANG A/B no-cull control + refresh-not-deferred test (fake clock; variant A = recovery sweep wrapped by the cull fold whose detached scan blocks indefinitely past 5m; variant B = identical sweep, no cull fold; assert recovery result preserved A==B, Sweeps==2 A==B, the tick-2 cursor-refresh fake-clock instant is EQUAL under A and B, the recovery-cursor wedge inputs are byte-identical, no torn write; NEGATIVE CONTROL A' that synchronously joins the scan must FAIL the refresh-not-deferred assertion); the B5 assertion-6 cooperative-hang bound (a scan selecting on cullCtx.Done() self-terminates at DefaultCullFoldTimeout); and (BC-619) the late-return-zero-write guard test — a scan that IGNORES ctx.Done() and returns after DefaultCullFoldTimeout performs ZERO cullable_entity UPSERTs; plus the B3 cost test (O(corpus), no events/audit/verdicts history scan, no new doctor block), the A5 test (a superseded verdict row produces NO cullable_entity row — verdicts.superseded_by_decision_id is NOT an artifact edge, PC3), and the A6 test (no kind=branch candidacy). The PG-backed two-role pgtest for the migration is PROVEN in the separate verifier/operator stage (your bwrap worktree has no PostgreSQL); still WRITE it correctly (apply clean, runtime role can DML, no SELECT *). (8) DOCS — CHANGELOG.md and the README.md front-door status/schema rows must reflect runtime schema 45 when migration 0045 lands. Decision D271 is ALREADY ratified in docs/decisions/decision-log.md (landed with the design) — do NOT add a new decision; D267 is an existing superseded decision the predicate nominates, not a new record. Ensure `cd go && go build ./... && go vet ./...` pass in your worktree (the PG pgtests SKIP in bwrap without PG — that is expected). Publish DRAFT.md summarizing each deliverable, the gate (G1-G4) and assertion (A1-A8/B1-B5/C1-C3/D1) each file discharges, the verified free 0045 slot, and the BC-618/BC-619 dispositions. Your source changes are captured via publish_source_changes.
